scope: APEXlang home dashboard, local terminal behavior and bilingual documentation

implementation.coverage: Bundled Oracle component families and reference documents; not compiler certification.
controls: Arrows, Page Up/Down and Home/End browse
Esc clears search or returns to actions
Enter in catalogue dispatches no operation

unit.includes: Actual bundled catalogue coverage and all rows reachable; independent search and selection; no dispatch from catalogue; missing/corrupt catalogue handling, retry and exit during loading; color and terminal-width handling.

checks: bare invocation opens the logo, six direct actions and the bundled APEXlang table
APEXlang search, first/last navigation, read-only Enter, Tab focus and wide dashboard
tools install has no preview toggle; review authorizes direct execution without running installation in this smoke
Enter on review directly removes an isolated managed-tool fixture and shows optional JSON
plugin installation is fixed to plugin-only and leaves tool options out
fixture SQLcl names are searchable; Enter tests the selected saved name; results return to the picker and refresh
Ctrl+C restores terminal input, cursor and normal screen
explicit TUI, catalogue search at 50x14 and 30x10, small-terminal resize and SIGTERM cleanup
